Sent for sampling post-race.

Badly held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 200 Metres.  C L Chau reported that with his mount stepping up in distance and drawing a favourable barrier he was able to hold a more forward position as he had been instructed.
Shifted out leaving the 900 Metres and was bumped.  Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 900 Metres lay in and made contact with CELESTIAL HARMONY.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  After the 300 Metres KA YING POWER then improved into a tight run between GLORIOUS EXPERT and RAGNARR.
Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 900 Metres made contact with the running rail when racing tight to the inside of RUN YES RUN which lay in and away from RAGNARR.
Bumped on jumping. Y L Chung was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 3 consecutive strides after the 200 Metres.

On jumping was crowded between RIDING HIGH and TSUEN WAN GLORY which shifted out.  When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight J Orman stated that after being positioned behind RAGNARR on straightening he was briefly held up behind that runner leaving the 400 Metres.  He said after then shifting to the outside of RAGNARR he continued to ride his mount along when positioned behind VIVA CHALEUR.  He added that near the 150 Metres when VIVA CHALEUR was laying out as it was being ridden along he then elected to shift to the inside of VIVA CHALEUR to obtain clear running as he was concerned that VIVA CHALEUR would continue to shift out.  He stated that when VIVA CHALEUR maintained a straight course thereafter he had some difficulty obtaining clear running for a short distance near the 100 Metres when improving into a tight run between VIVA CHALEUR and RUN YES RUN.  The Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Orman were reasonable in the circumstances.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with VIVA CHALEUR.  Passing the 900 Metres was bumped on the hindquarters by RAGNARR which shifted out when being steadied away from VERBIER.  GLORIOUS EXPERT was then obliged to race very wide and without cover thereafter.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Bumped on jumping.  H Bowman stated that the intention was to find a position with cover.  He said in the early stages when he was unable to comply with his instructions he allowed RIDING HIGH to stride forward but when unable to cross the leaders RIDING HIGH was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added as a result in the Home Straight his mount was left without a finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out at the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.   Apprentice P N Wong stated that she was obliged to make use of her mount in the early stages to race outside the lead which resulted in TSUEN WAN GLORY then giving ground in the Home Straight.  Trainer K L Man concurred with the views of Apprentice Wong and also stated that the horse was disadvantaged by being up in weight as compared to its last start win.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of TSUEN WAN GLORY, a last start winner, was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, TSUEN WAN GLORY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Despite being ridden along in the early stages did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
As the start was effected lowered its head, resulting in STRAIGHT TO GLORY jumping awkwardly and losing ground.

After arriving at the starting gates was found to have lost its left front plate, resulting in the horse having to be reshod.  Was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Bumped on jumping.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.  Between the 450 Metres and the 250 Metres was badly held up behind FLOWING RICHES when that runner did not improve.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.

M L Yeung stated that the only explanation he could offer for his mount’s disappointing performance was the fact that it was left racing without cover today and when it won its previous race start on 28 September 2025 it finished the race off well when it obtained cover.  Trainer K H Ting concurred with the views expressed by M L Yeung and stated the intention was to find cover behind STRAIGHT TO GLORY but when that runner jumped awkwardly Jockey Yeung was unable to comply with the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres raced tight to the outside of SIGHT HERMOSO which shifted out when being checked away from FLOWING RICHES.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing tight to the outside of SIGHT HERMOSO.
Bumped on jumping.  Approaching the 100 Metres was eased when crowded between ENJOY GOLF and PRESTIGE HALL which lay in and away from GIANT BALLON.
Bumped on jumping.

Proved difficult to load into the starting gates.  Trainer W Y So was advised that a warning would be placed on the barrier manners of the horse.  The Stewards ruled that THE PROMISE will be required to attend barrier practice to the satisfaction of the Starter before being allowed to race again.  Near the 100 Metres lay out towards LITTLE MONSTER which was giving ground and as a result was steadied.

Made contact with the right side of the starting gate on jumping.  Near the 700 Metres was steadied and became unbalanced when crowded by SAME TO YOU (A Badel) which lay out as A Badel made some effort to correct his mount.  A Badel was advised to exercise more care.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was crowded between FLASH STAR and CALIFORNIA BLITZ which shifted in after being bumped by PRESTIGE HALL.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Raced keenly in the early stages.  A Atzeni stated that with his mount stepping up distance and blinkers being applied for the first time he was asked to take up a more forward position. Trainer D A Hayes confirmed the instructions issued.
L Ferraris reported that in the Home Straight his mount hung in and proved reluctant to shift to the outside of BEAUTY VIVA for some distance near the 200 Metres.

As the start was effected stood flat-footed and as a result lost ground.  The barrier manners of DOUBLE WIN were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DOUBLE WIN will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.  K C Leung reported that when his mount stood flat-footed at the start he injured his finger of his left hand as he encouraged the horse to jump from the starting gates.  K C Leung was examined by the Chief Medical Officer and passed fit to fulfil his remaining race riding engagements.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Before being allowed to race again, SUPER GOLDENDRAGON will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

horses.incident_text: Jumped only fairly. Near the 350 Metres lay in and was eased when positioned close to ROMANTIC PARTY which was giving ground.  Over the final 150 Metres was held up behind FUN TOGETHER and as a consequence could not be ridden out to the finish of the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <20/10/2025 Additional Veterinary Report> After the race WE CAN PARTY was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. WE CAN PARTY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D Eustace this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to have a right front tendon injury. Before being allowed to race again, WE CAN PARTY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

In this incident LUCKY MAN was accidentally struck across the head by the whip of B Avdulla, rider of RAGING RAPIDS.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

He added as a result SMART FAT CAT found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 350 Metres M L Yeung dropped his whip.  After the event M L Yeung could offer no excuse for his mount’s failure to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned Z Purton stated that his mount travelled satisfactorily in the early stages outside the lead.  He said from the 700 Metres his mount came under pressure before giving ground in the Home Straight but he could offer no reason for its disappointing performance.  Trainer K W Lui stated that the horse had pleased him coming into today’s race but could offer no explanation for its performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of PACKING PHOENIX, a last start winner, was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, PACKING PHOENIX will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination. C L Chau reported that near the 850 Metres his mount became unbalanced when it lay in towards the running rail.
Leaving the 900 Metres became unbalanced when crowded for room.  In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 600 Metres was steadied when unable to improve between MY WISH and VOYAGE BUBBLE.
Near the 500 Metres was steadied away from HAPPY TOGETHER.  Over the final 300 Metres was held up for clear running and could not be ridden out to the finish of the race.

On jumping was crowded between MY WISH and RED LION, both of which shifted ground.  VICTOR THE WINNER was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages from a wide barrier.  Near the 350 Metres was briefly held up for clear running behind SWORD POINT.

Passing the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid MY WISH (A Badel) which shifted in when not clear.  A Badel was severely reprimanded.  In this incident HAPPY TOGETHER was crowded between VOYAGE BUBBLE and MOMENTS IN TIME.  Near the 300 Metres M F Poon dropped his whip.  When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages M F Poon stated that the instructions were to take up an on-pace position behind the leaders.  He said in the early stages he was unable to cross runners to his inside which resulted in VOYAGE BUBBLE being caught in a three wide position.  He stated that as a result he then elected to ride his mount forward with a view to crossing HAPPY TOGETHER and at the same time requiring MY WISH to have to be ridden forward to cross and race outside the lead.  He said after being crowded by MY WISH leaving the 900 Metres he was then obliged to race in a position three wide and without cover thereafter.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions were to hold an on-pace position whilst acknowledging it may have been difficult for the horse to obtain cover with a number of light weight runners drawn to its inside.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Poon that he had made an error of judgement in the early stages by continuing forward to make too much use of his mount to cross runners to his inside, particularly with his mount racing first up and carrying top weight of 135 lbs.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

He added that when able to shift to the outside entering the Home Straight his mount ran on well.  Sent for sampling post-race.

He added that in the Home Straight YUEN LONG ELITE then finished the race off only fairly as a consequence. Near the 150 Metres was checked when crowded between WINNING GOLD which shifted out slightly and FORTUNE BOY (K Teetan) which shifted in slightly whilst being ridden along.  K Teetan was advised to exercise more care.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
